_about: Derived but tracked, on edition/geo/'s precedent: pdfs/ are symlinks outside the repository, so a clone cannot rebuild this. Built by `harness scans extract --all --commit`. Per page: `master` is the full-page image scans/ is cut from, `offset` is the integer shift from the legacy pdftoppm render space into master space (master = render - offset), and `images` are the embedded photographs with `rect` in MASTER pixels, rounded outward. `rendered: true` marks the three masterless RGB pages, which are rasterised at 300 dpi as before and do not move. `_sources` digests the PDFs these pages were cut from, and `harness scans audit` re-reads them: a source that changed underneath this file is a finding, not a silence.
